html:
What this means for your business

A feature is useful only when staff can operate it, the customer path still works, and someone can recover the account or data. Boring is a compliment when money is moving.

What to watch

  • One person is the only manual.
  • An outage plan that begins after the outage.
  • A tool added because a demo looked smart.
  • No export, backup, owner, support route, or replacement path.

Do this next

  1. Write the five jobs that cannot stop.
  2. Name the owner and backup operator for each.
  3. Test offline, restore, recovery, and support steps.
  4. Remove features that create more work than value.

When Little Fight fits

We keep what works, connect what should talk, and build only when the business needs to own the tool. No confetti required.

Get a plain-English second opinion

Sources and further reading

Product features and rules can change. Use the linked source as the current word.

insight.answer: Choose technology for a normal busy day and a bad day. It should be understandable, supportable, recoverable, and owned by the business.
